policy: Deliberate, human-reviewed exclusions from the software-catalog review queue. Each primary repository below was reviewed and intentionally NOT catalogued in pages/SOFTWARE.md (profile/infrastructure repos, websites, test/smoke repos, rename duplicates of catalogued repos, or private mirrors). Recorded here so they stop resurfacing as 'primary_repo_requires_manual_review' on every GitHub inventory refresh. This file NEVER promotes a repository into the catalog; it only acknowledges a not-catalog decision. A repository is removed from this list if the exclusion no longer holds (e.g. a mirror becomes a primary project).

reasons.profile_repo: The @owner profile/index repository itself; pages/SOFTWARE.md explicitly excludes it.
reasons.profile_infrastructure: Profile-page infrastructure (README, links, identity) rather than a software project.
reasons.test_repo: Test or integration-smoke repository, not a citable software product.
reasons.website: A website / GitHub Pages site, not a software library or tool.
reasons.rename_duplicate: A rename or variant of a repository already present in the curated catalog.
reasons.private_mirror: A public mirror of a private working project; the primary project is tracked elsewhere.

exclusions.note: Public research and software index (this site's own source repo).
Integration smoke test for the template release orchestrator (marked do-not-cite).
Active Inference Institute GitHub Pages website.
Underscore variant of the catalogued docxology/crescent-city.
Public mirror of working/prior_cognitive_art in docxology/projects.
Empty / unused repository removed per principal direction.
